title: 第10章 选兽竞拍
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
罗影的呼吸几不可闻地一窒。

    他没有马上伸手去抓，而是将【赴死蚁】身上发出的两道光柱，与之前所看到的几只一根一根地在识海里面比较过去。

    识海中那本《万兽衍策》，随着他的视线移动，这本书也无言地翻动起来。一条虫、一张纸。

    比着比着，他心里慢慢透出个章程来。

    普通的【赴死蚁】，即使是那些守护在草人脚边、半步不退的，身上的两根光柱里更亮、更粗的，永远都是通往【无惧蚁】的那一根。

    通往【赴难勇蚁】的那根，则瘦削、黯淡，缩在旁边，像是一株没长开的苗。

    这样和冯教习刚才说的话是一致的。

    “【无惧蚁】好走，【赴难勇蚁】要难练上百倍。”

    难走的路，本就没有几个肯往上长的。

    但是眼前这只偏偏反了过来。

    它通往【赴难勇蚁】的光柱又粗又亮，亮到几乎要把旁边的【无惧蚁】发出的光也给压下去了。

    罗影盯着他，看过了两息时间。

    这根光柱的末端，还会继续发出新的光芒，在新光芒之后，则有一团无法准确形容的、但又十分有冲击力的影子。

    【撼岳勇蚁】。

    稀有级别。

    他上辈子做了很多年的学问，见惯了一窝蛋里总有一两个异数。

    同样的一颗卵，同样的一样食物，但是有一个天生就有比兄弟姐妹多出的一股说不出道不出的东西。

    书中将这叫做“个体变异中的极端正向偏离”。

    在一万次之中，都不一定能够产生出一个。

    而这一只【赴死蚁】，便是这五千只里头，那个“未必出得了一个”。

    罗影慢慢的站了起来，环顾四周的时候，目光一格一格地落在了每一个木柜上。

    头上的地方好像有一阵很轻的钟磬声传过来。

    一个时辰快结束了。

    他不敢再去浪费时间了。

    在镜中天地中，五千号人各自对着一面柜子，瞧着是各看各的，可那些柜子里的虫，却是初契堂里实实在在的同一批。

    他这边看中了，旁人那边，未必看不见。

    罗影心一定，把前世做田野调查所采用的笨方法，也全部都用上了。

    挨着个儿全看，是断断来不及的，便先挑要紧的看。

    他先把沾着【食蚁兽】尿的那一片草人附近，仔仔细细筛了一遍。

    食蚁兽，是蚂蚁世界中骨子里最怕的东西。

    连窝端、连卵绝的那种怕。

    顶着这股味道，大模大样地站到最好吃食的旁边，满打满算之下，居然也就只有八到九只。

    在八九只中，根、骨、身、量都参差不齐。

    他又将手臂伸到散发出【穿山甲】气味的地方。

    穿山甲凶归凶，到底比食蚁兽差着一层，敢凑近的蚁便多了，黑压压一片，他一个时辰看不完。

    罗影就只抽着看了十之一二。

    在十之一二的范围内，他还真捡到一只漏。

    那是一只躲在穿山甲草人脚边，大小差不多，没有引起多少注意的【赴死蚁】。

    但是它身上无畏的心境，却和食蚁兽区里的几只一般无二的浓！

    放在低一级的草人身上，按理说会被别人一眼瞥过。

    看不破的，便错过了。

    看得破的，才捡得着。

    罗影心里默数。

    满打满算，能算得上“最高一等无畏之心“的，约莫十只。

    这十只里头，又身强体壮、根骨齐整的，只剩三只。

    而这三只里头，那根【赴难勇蚁】的光柱压过【无惧蚁】、尽头还续着【撼岳勇蚁】新光的......

    只有一只。

    就是他最先看见的那一只。

    守在最烈的食蚁兽尿旁、触须一翘一翘、半分惧色也无的那一只。

    罗影望着它，心里头那点说不清的滋味，又沉了沉。

    ......

    青石台上。

    冯教习半阖着眼，枯瘦的手搭在那只青玉钵的边沿。

    钵里，青灰色的【万镜蜃贝】壳一开一合，吐着极淡的雾。

    老人借着这贝，能模模糊糊地照见镜中那一重重天地里的光景。

    几千个半大孩子，趴在柜子上看虫，有的眉头紧锁，有的抓耳挠腮，有的看一眼便泄了气，蹲在墙角发怔。

    冯教习看惯了。

    他心里头，却另有一桩事一直悬着。

    御兽反选。

    稀有珍贵的兽，灵气足，才会择主而栖。

    这道理他年年都说，年年都添一句“几十年也未必碰得上一回”。

    今年这一批赴死蚁里头，他是知道有几只成色极好的。

    打从把它们摆进柜子那天起，他便留了个心眼，盼着能碰上一回。

    可一个时辰快尽了。

    五千号人。

    愣是没有一只虫，肯主动往谁身上凑、认谁做主。

    冯教习在心里轻轻叹了口气，那点指望，又落了空。

    也是。

    他摸着钵沿，自个儿宽慰自个儿。

    寒门也好，富户也罢，能让兽反选的天才，几十年出一个，哪是年年都有的。

    他没再多想，枯手在钵沿上一叩。

    ......

    罗影正盯着那只虫出神，身侧忽然挨过来一个人。

    是李子诚。

    他不知什么时候踱了过来，背着手，脸上带着点尘埃落定的松快。

    “我选好了。”

    李子诚压低了声音说。

    罗影回过神：

    “哪一只？”

    李子诚挠了挠头，那神情倒有几分不好意思。

    “说来也怪。

    方才我在柜子跟前转，有那么几只虫，老是朝我这边凑，触须冲我直摆，怪亲昵的。”

    他顿了顿：

    “我也说不上为啥。想了想，还是头一只跟我打招呼的吧，瞧着顺眼。”

    罗影“嗯”了一声，没立刻接话。

    他顺着李子诚方才转过的那一格一格柜子，把视线扫了过去。

    识海里，书页悄没声地翻动。

    扫到一半，他的心微微动了一下。
content_en:
Luo Ying's breath almost inaudibly choked.
He did not immediately reach out to grab it, but compared the two light beams emitted by the [Death Ant] with the ones he had seen before, one by one in the sea of ​​consciousness.
The book "Evolution of Ten Thousand Beasts" in the sea of ​​​​consciousness, as his eyes moved, the book also began to turn over silently.A worm, a piece of paper.
Comparing with each other, a plan slowly emerged in his mind.
Ordinary [Fearless Ants], even those guarding the feet of the straw man, never retreating half a step, the brighter and thicker of the two light beams on their bodies is always the one leading to [Fearless Ants].
The root leading to [Brave Ant in Disaster] is thin, dim, and shrinks to the side, like a seedling that has not grown.
This is consistent with what Professor Feng said just now.
"[Fearless Ant] is easy to walk, but [Brave Ant] is a hundred times harder to practice."
It's a difficult road, and few people are willing to go up it.
But the one in front of me happened to be the other way around.
The light beam leading to the [Fearless Ant] is thick and bright, so bright that it almost suppresses the light emitted by the [Fearless Ant] next to it.
Luo Ying stared at him for two breaths.
The end of this light pillar will continue to emit new light. Behind the new light, there is a shadow that cannot be accurately described, but is very impactful.
【Shaking Yue Yongant】.
Rare level.
He had been a scholar for many years in his previous life, and he was used to seeing that there were always one or two oddities in a nest of eggs.
The same egg, the same food, but one of them was born with an indescribable something more than his brothers and sisters.
The book calls this "extreme positive deviations in individual variation."
In ten thousand times, one may not be able to be produced.
And this [Death Ant] is the one among the five thousand that "may not be able to come out."
Luo Ying stood up slowly, and when he looked around, his eyes fell on each wooden cabinet one by one.
There seemed to be a gentle sound of bells coming from above my head.
The hour is almost over.
He didn't dare waste any more time.
In the world in the mirror, five thousand people each face a cabinet, looking at each other in their own way, but the insects in those cabinets are actually the same group in the Chuqi Hall.
He is interested in it, but others may not be able to see it.
Luo Ying was determined, and he used all the stupid methods he had used in his previous life for field research.
It’s too late to look at them all at once, so I’ll pick out the important ones first.
He first carefully sifted the area around the straw man stained with [Anteater] urine.
Anteaters are the most feared thing in the ant world.
The kind of fear that even the nest will be destroyed and the eggs will be extinct.
Despite this smell, I stood proudly next to the most delicious food. After all calculations, there were only eight or nine.
Among the eight or nine, the roots, bones, body, and weight are all uneven.
He stretched his arm to the place where the smell of [pangolin] came out.
Pangolins are more dangerous than anteaters. There are so many ants that dare to get close to them. It's so dark that he can't see them all in an hour.
Luo Ying only glanced at ten or two.
Within the range of 10 to 20%, he actually picked up a leak.
It was a [Death Ant] hiding at the feet of the Pangolin Grass Man. It was about the same size and did not attract much attention.
But its fearless mood is the same as the ones in the anteater area!
If you put it on a low-level straw man, it stands to reason that others will glance at it.
If you can't see through it, you will miss it.
Only those who can see through can be picked up.
Luo Ying counted silently in his mind.
After all, there are about ten of them that can be regarded as "the highest level of fearlessness".
Among these ten, only three are left who are strong and have good bones.
And among these three, the beam of light of [Brave Ant in Disaster] overwhelmed [Fearless Ant], and the new light of [Yue-shaking Brave Ant] continued at the end...
There is only one.
It was the one he saw first.
The one standing next to the most powerful anteater's urine, its tentacles rising and falling, showing no sign of fear.
Luo Ying looked at it, and the indescribable feeling in his heart sank again.
...
On the bluestone platform.
Teacher Feng half-closed his eyes and placed his skinny hands on the edge of the green jade bowl.
In the bowl, the blue-grey [Ten Thousand Mirror Mirage] shells opened and closed, spitting out a very light mist.
Through this shell, the old man could vaguely see the scenes in the world in the mirror.
Thousands of half-year-old children were lying on the cabinets looking for insects. Some frowned, some scratched their ears and cheeks, and some were discouraged after just one glance and squatted in the corner in a daze.
Teacher Feng is used to it.
There was something else that was still hanging in his mind.
The beast control is reversed.
Only rare and precious beasts with sufficient aura will choose their master and live there.
He said this every year, and every year he added, "It may not happen once in decades."
Among this year's batch of dying ants, he knew that there were some that were in excellent condition.
From the day he put them in the cabinet, he kept a close eye on them, hoping to run into them once.
But the hour is almost up.
Five thousand people.
Surprisingly, not a single insect is willing to take the initiative to get involved with anyone and accept who has the final say.
Teacher Feng sighed softly in his heart, and his hope failed again.
Too.
He touched the edge of the bowl and comforted himself.
No matter whether you are from a poor family or a wealthy family, a genius who can make the beast turn against you will appear every few decades, but they will not be available every year.
He didn't think any more and tapped the rim of the bowl with his withered hand.
...
Luo Ying was staring at the insect in a trance when a person suddenly approached him.
It's Li Zicheng.
He walked over at some point, with his hands behind his back, a look of relief on his face as the dust settled.
"I've chosen."
Li Zicheng lowered his voice and said.
Luo Ying came back to his senses:
"Which one?"
Li Zicheng scratched his head, looking a little embarrassed.
“It’s strange to say.
I was walking around in front of the cabinet just now, and there were a few insects that kept coming towards me, and their tentacles were waving towards me, which was very affectionate."
He paused:
"I can't say why. After thinking about it, it was probably the first one to say hello to me. It's pleasing to the eye."
Luo Ying said "hmm" and didn't answer immediately.
He scanned the cabinets that Li Zicheng had just turned around.
In the sea of ​​consciousness, the pages of the book turned silently.
Halfway through scanning, his heart moved slightly.
